evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any questions or concerns about this move at all?' — asked right after email confirmation, before any address/logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'No' to the concerns question — no-concern fix applied.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'A number of factors involved in determining move time but the most important one is how well prepared you are... the better that you are consolidating things in the boxes... that would really help keep the time down.'

top_strength: Textbook estimate anchor — explicitly tied the 3.5-4.5 hour range to the specific combination of third-floor stair access on one end and an eleventh-floor walk-plus-broken-freight-elevator on the other, so the number felt earned rather than generic.
coaching_note: Communication (day-before call, crew lead name, inbox updates) was the one differentiator never mentioned — worth folding in alongside the On-Time Guarantee since the call already had room for a thorough Stage 2 wrap-up.
grading_notes: Judgment call: 'I truly believe we are the best movers in town, I know it'll take great care of your move' was credited as satisfying the SYA commit-to-rate/experience framing in spirit, consistent with similar credit given elsewhere in this batch, even though it doesn't use the exact '100k moves' script language.
